job: Perf pass with before/after proof against the PB01 baseline: GLB optimization, font/bundle audit, re-measure. No quality or feature loss - visually indistinguishable or revert.
context: PB01 baseline artifact: perf/PB01-baseline-2026-08-14.json (route HTML bytes, total static bytes, 12 largest assets, 88.2 kB shared first-load). The founder's standing rule: no perf change ships without a before/after pair against that file.
rejectionGates: if perf/PB01-baseline-2026-08-14.json is missing, stop - the baseline is the contract
any visual change beyond pixel-identical model rendering means revert that asset
instructions: PB02 GLBs: npm i -D @gltf-transform/cli, then for each of the 6 files in app/public/models: gltf-transform optimize in.glb out.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp. Register the meshopt decoder in the story loader (drei useGLTF.setDecoderPath / meshoptDecoder import) ONLY if compression is applied. Capture before/after screenshots with scripts/meadow-proof.mjs fixed cameras; if vegetationTextureCoverage or any visible difference appears, revert that asset. KTX2 only if a texture inspection shows it pays for the transcoder weight.

PB03 fonts/bundles: add @next/bundle-analyzer behind process.env.ANALYZE === '1' in next.config.mjs. Run ANALYZE=1 GH_PAGES=1 npm run build; save the treemap HTML into perf/. Verify: three/r3f absent from non-story app routes' first load; wagmi/viem only on chain surfaces; maplibre only /land. Move violations behind next/dynamic. For the 4 @fontsource-variable families: grep usage; drop any unused axis/family import.

PB04 re-measure: rebuild GH_PAGES, regenerate the same byte table as PB01 (see the PowerShell in the git history of perf/PB01) into perf/PB04-after-<date>.json, plus Lighthouse: npx lighthouse https://aurahomes.fun --preset=desktop --output=json --output-path=perf/lighthouse-after.json. Ship only if routes' first-load bytes are <= baseline and LCP <= 2.0s.
Also in scope if time allows - NW01 (see its own scaffold): the two measured one-time compile stalls.

verify.note: meadow-proof needs a quiet machine and the approved baseline dir (Kin/aura-r03-baseline-20260813 on the build machine)
